summary: End-to-end verification of Ad Spend Log + Friday Import Nudge features on backend + frontend. All 10 requested pytest tests pass (test_ad_spend_nudge.py 5/5 + test_report_v2.py 5/5). Frontend: import-nudge-banner renders on Command Center with 'Import it now' button that correctly navigates to Quality Customer Maximizer section (CSV import area visible). WeeklyWinReport shows 3 big stats (Deals Redeemed / Revenue Proven / Ad Spend with 'vs $X prior wk' subtext), AdSpendLog strip renders below the so-far line with all required testids (platform, label, amount, add-btn) and $50/week hint. UI round-trip verified: add spend (facebook / 'TEST ui boost' / $25) -> success toast 'Spend logged' -> entry row visible with correct date/platform/label/amount -> delete via trash removes it. Regression: Monday auto-email strip present, prize payouts + 8-channel activity render, no console errors. Backend log scan shows zero 'Win report scheduler tick failed' errors. All test-created rows cleaned up; import-status back to nudge:true (real state preserved).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~3190 lines — the recurring feedback from iter 15/19 still stands: extract maximizer/, reports/, auth/, scheduler/ modules. Non-blocking but debt accrues.

Historical NameError 'UNSUBSCRIBE_BASE_URL' appears in older backend.err.log entries (dated before current fix). The bug is already fixed in server.py (variable is UNSUBSCRIBE_BASE) — verified by hitting /api/maximizer/report-email/send-now which returns 200 with stub payload. Safe to ignore old log lines; consider log rotation or a startup log-truncate to avoid confusion for future testers.
AdSpendLog.js truncates to entries.slice(0, 6) — fine for MVP but if owners scale to many entries per week they'll silently lose visibility. Consider a 'show all N' toggle or scrollable list.
The banner navigate button uses onNavigate('maximizer') from App.js state — no deep-link to the CSV card within the Maximizer page (owner still has to scroll). Minor UX polish, not a bug.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 pytest, ad-spend CRUD/validation, weekly-report adSpend section, import-status shape, weekly-report v2 regression)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (banner + nav + all AdSpendLog testids + add/delete round-trip + toast + regression)

rca of the issue: No product bugs found in this iteration. One historical log-noise issue traced: earlier revisions of _send_win_report_email() referenced UNSUBSCRIBE_BASE_URL (env var name) instead of UNSUBSCRIBE_BASE (Python constant), producing NameError tracebacks in backend.err.log. Current server.py line 2082 correctly uses UNSUBSCRIBE_BASE; live curl of /api/maximizer/report-email/send-now returns 200 with stub payload confirming the fix. Recommend rotating/truncating supervisor logs to reduce false alarms for future testing agents.
